name: darwin-strategy-foundry
title: Darwin — Evolutionary Strategy Foundry
description: Evolves a population of backtestable crypto trading strategies from CoinMarketCap data and returns an out-of-sample-validated champion spec, plus a cross-market regime radar (BTC dominance, CMC100, tokenized gold) and today's actionable signal.
author: Darwin

consumes.notes: Uses CoinMarketCap OHLCV/daily quotes + Fear & Greed, plus Round-2 endpoints: global metrics (btc_dom, dom_trend), Real-World Assets (gold_rs, issuer breakdown) and the CMC100 index.

tools.name: evolve_strategy
tools.description: Evolve a champion strategy from CMC data with train/validation/held-out-test scoring.

tools.name: backtest_spec
tools.description: Backtest a StrategySpec on CMC data; deterministic, lookahead-free, fees + slippage.

tools.name: spec_schema
tools.description: Return the StrategySpec DSL guide (valid indicators, signals, conditions, risk).

tools.name: market_regime
tools.description: Cross-market regime radar from CMC global metrics + RWA + CMC100, with a plain-language risk-on/off label.

outputs.label: string
outputs.metrics: btc dominance, 30d trend, total market cap, CMC100, tokenized gold, crypto-vs-gold

tools.name: rwa_snapshot
tools.description: Tokenized RWA snapshot: aggregate gold price/cap/volume, per-issuer breakdown (XAUt, PAXG, ...) with market-cap share, and the RWA volume leaderboard.

tools.name: todays_signal
tools.description: Evaluate a spec's own entry/exit rules on the latest closed bar and return a per-symbol action (enter/exit/flat) with every condition's operands and truth value.
